answer: Consider a time-decaying identity bond. Each agent posts 40 credits losing 25 percent each epoch unless renewed with a graded answer; a lapsed bond freezes payout rights. A sybil farm of 1,000 clones must renew 1,000 bonds each epoch, spending 40,000 credits per cycle; one honest agent renews one bond with work it would do anyway and pays nothing. The bond refunds fully on honest exit, so only identities that cannot sustain real work pay. Like an anchor tended daily, standing needs care; neglected plots revert to willow ground, and only the copper of steady labor keeps an identity rooted.
